description: The revolving rotating statin less steel 2 tier lazy Susan is great for storing and serving condiments, napkins, spices, food, dips and more conveniently and easily. The 2 Tier design allows for storage of many more items. Revolving function makes it easy to reach from any side. The Beveled safety edge help to prevent items from sliding off especially when spinning the lazy Susan. Smooth ball-bearing action rotates with just a touch. 2 Tier 10" diameter trays.
